subject: DI04019011

h.en: 7.1.1 The turbine must drive its own compressor too
h.gu: 7.1.1 Turbineએ પોતાનો Compressor પણ ચલાવવો પડે

body.en:
Start with the situation

A gas turbine may produce large turbine power, but a significant part drives the compressor; only the remainder is net output before other auxiliaries.

Definition / principle

A gas-turbine plant compresses gas, adds heat and expands it through a turbine for mechanical output. The ideal air-standard model is the Brayton cycle.

Understand why

Distinguish a real open combustion engine from the ideal closed air-standard cycle used for calculation; real mass flow/properties can change through combustion.

Application / illustration

Gas turbines serve power generation, aircraft propulsion, mechanical drives and combined heat/power arrangements.

Common mistake / conditions

Turbine gross output is not net plant power; compressor work cannot be omitted.

Turbine work50 and compressor work35kJ/kg:net work?

15kJ/kg before any separately counted auxiliaries.
body.gu:
પરિસ્થિતિથી શરૂઆત

Gas turbine મોટું turbine power આપે,પણ મોટો ભાગ compressor ચલાવે;બાકી outputમાંથી auxiliaries પણ બાદ થાય.

Definition / Principle

Gas-turbine plant gas compress,heat add,પછી turbineમાં expand કરી mechanical output આપે.Ideal air-standard model Brayton cycle છે.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Real open combustion engine,calculationનું ideal closed air-standard cycle જુદાં છે;combustionથી real mass flow/properties બદલાય.

Application / ઉદાહરણ

Gas turbines power generation,aircraft propulsion,mechanical drives,combined heat/powerમાં વપરાય.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Turbine gross output net plant power નથી;compressor work છોડાય નહિ.

Turbine Work50,Compressor Work35kJ/kg હોય તો Net Work?

અલગ counted auxiliaries પહેલાં15kJ/kg.

body.en:
Understand why

Classify open/closed cycle, single/two/multiple shaft, aero-derivative/heavy-duty, application and regeneration/intercooling/reheating configuration.

Core parts:inlet/filter, compressor, combustor or external heater, turbine, shaft/load, exhaust/heat recovery, starting, lubrication, controls and safety protection.

Common mistake / conditions

Single/two-shaft classification concerns mechanical coupling, not simply counting compressor blade rows.
body.gu:
કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Open/closed cycle,single/two/multiple shaft,aero-derivative/heavy-duty,application,regeneration/intercooling/reheatingથી classify કરો.

Core parts:inlet/filter,compressor,combustor/external heater,turbine,shaft/load,exhaust/heat recovery,starting,lubrication,controls,safety protection.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Single/two-shaft mechanical coupling બતાવે,ફક્ત compressor blade rowsની ગણતરી નહિ.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Air enters from atmosphere, fuel burns in compressed air and hot products expand before exhaust leaves the plant.

Construction:part and purpose

Inlet/filter admits clean air with acceptable pressure loss.

Compressor raises air pressure using shaft work.

Combustor mixes fuel/air and sustains controlled burning.

Turbine supplies compressor and net load work through the shaft train.

Exhaust may feed heat recovery; starting, control and protection support safe operation.

Working:flow and reason

Air is filtered and compressed.

Fuel heat raises gas temperature with a real pressure loss through combustion equipment.

Hot gas expands through turbine stages and turns the shaft.

Part of output drives the compressor; remaining output drives the load after losses/auxiliaries.

Exhaust is discharged or recovered in a downstream system.

Common mistake / conditions

Actual open-cycle mass/properties differ from a constant-cp air-standard model; emissions and turbine inlet temperature are controlled limits.

Does reheat automatically improve thermal efficiency?

No. Extra work and extra heat input must both enter the full balance.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Atmospheric air compressed થાય,તેમાં fuel burn થાય,hot products expand થઈ exhaust plant બહાર જાય.

Construction:ભાગ અને કામ

Inlet/filter clean air acceptable pressure lossથી લે.

Compressor shaft workથી air pressure વધારે.

Combustor fuel/air mix,controlled burning કરે.

Turbine shaft trainથી compressor,net loadનું work આપે.

Exhaust heat recoveryમાં જઈ શકે;starting,control,protection safe operation આપે.

Working:Flow અને કારણ

Air filter,compress થાય.

Combustion equipmentના real pressure loss સાથે fuel heat temperature વધારે.

Hot gas turbine stagesમાં expand થઈ shaft ફેરવે.

Outputનો ભાગ compressorમાં,બાકી losses/auxiliaries પછી loadમાં જાય.

Exhaust discharge કે downstream recoveryમાં જાય.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Actual open-cycle mass/properties constant-cp air-standardથી જુદાં;emissions,turbine inlet temperature controlled limits છે.

Reheatથી Thermal Efficiency આપમેળે વધે?

ના.Extra work,extra heat input બન્ને full balanceમાં જોઈએ.

body.en:
Definition / principle

A working gas circulates through compressor, external heater, turbine and cooler without intentional exhaust/make-up exchange each cycle.

Construction:part and purpose

A compressor circulates/pressurises the closed working gas.

An external heater transfers heat through a separating surface.

A turbine extracts shaft work.

A cooler rejects heat before compressor re-entry.

Seals, inventory/pressure controls and source/sink systems support the loop.

Working:flow and reason

Gas is compressed from low to high pressure.

External heating raises temperature without intended mixing with combustion products.

Turbine expansion supplies compressor and net output.

Cooler removes heat and gas returns to inlet state approximately under steady operation.

Common mistake / conditions

Closed cycle does not mean perfectly sealed forever or lossless; heat-exchanger pressure drops, leakage and source temperature limits remain.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Working gas compressor,external heater,turbine,coolerમાં circulate થાય,દરેક cycleમાં intentional exhaust/make-up exchange નહિ.

Construction:ભાગ અને કામ

Compressor closed gas circulate/pressurise કરે.

External heater separating surfaceથી heat આપે.

Turbine shaft work લે.

Cooler compressor પહેલાં heat reject કરે.

Seals,inventory/pressure controls,source/sink systems loopને ટેકો આપે.

Working:Flow અને કારણ

Gas lowથી high pressure compress થાય.

External heating temperature વધારે,combustion products સાથે intended mixing વગર.

Turbine expansion compressor,net output આપે.

Cooler heat કાઢે,steadyમાં gas આશરે inlet stateમાં પાછો આવે.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Closed cycle એટલે હંમેશાં perfect seal/lossless નહિ;heat-exchanger pressure drops,leakage,source limits રહે.

h.gu: 7.2.1 P–v અને T–s પર Brayton Processes

body.en:
Definition / principle

Ideal air-standard Brayton:1→2 isentropic compression; 2→3 constant-pressure heat addition; 3→4 isentropic expansion; 4→1 constant-pressure heat rejection.

Understand why

OnT–s, the isentropic legs are vertical; constant-pressure heating/cooling are curved. OnP–v, the high/low-pressure legs are horizontal; compression/expansion are curved.

Common mistake / conditions

A real open engine need not physically route exhaust back through a cooler; the ideal cycle closes its thermodynamic model to calculate performance.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Ideal air-standard Brayton:1→2 isentropic compression;2→3 constant-pressure heat addition;3→4 isentropic expansion;4→1 constant-pressure heat rejection.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

T–sમાં isentropic legs vertical,constant-pressure heating/cooling curved.P–vમાં high/low-pressure legs horizontal,compression/expansion curved.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Real open engine exhaustને coolerથી પાછો લાવે જરૂરી નહિ;ideal cycle performance માટે thermodynamic model close કરે.

body.en:
Definition / principle

For ideal gas, constantcp, gamma, isentropic machines, no pressure losses and equal compressor/turbine pressure ratio rp:T2/T1=T3/T4=rp^((gamma−1)/gamma).

wc=cp(T2−T1); wt=cp(T3−T4); wnet=wt−wc; qin=cp(T3−T2); eta=wnet/qin=1−1/rp^((gamma−1)/gamma).

Back-work ratio=wc/wt; work ratio=wnet/wt. Power=mdot wnet using the stated ideal common mass flow.

Common mistake / conditions

Do not claim increasingrp always improves actual net power. For fixedT1, T3, the ideal maximum-specific-work ratio is(T3/T1)^[gamma/(2(gamma−1))] under the listed assumptions.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Ideal gas,constant cp,gamma,isentropic machines,no pressure loss,equal compressor/turbine ratio rpમાં T2/T1=T3/T4=rp^((gamma−1)/gamma).

wc=cp(T2−T1);wt=cp(T3−T4);wnet=wt−wc;qin=cp(T3−T2);eta=wnet/qin=1−1/rp^((gamma−1)/gamma).

Back-work ratio=wc/wt;work ratio=wnet/wt.Stated ideal common mass flowમાં power=mdot wnet.

Common Mistake / શરતો

rp વધારવાથી actual net power હંમેશાં વધે એવું નહિ.Fixed T1,T3માં listed assumptions હેઠળ ideal maximum-specific-work ratio=(T3/T1)^[gamma/(2(gamma−1))].

body.en:
Given and model

T1=300K, T3=1200K, rp6, gamma1.4, cp1.005kJ/(kg·K), mdot2kg/s; ideal cycle.

Step-by-step solution

  1. a=rp^(.4/1.4)=1.668510; T2=500.553K; T4=719.204K
  2. wc=201.556kJ/kg; wt=483.200kJ/kg; wnet=281.644kJ/kg
  3. qin=702.944kJ/kg; eta≈40.0663%; power≈563.287kW

Common mistake / conditions

Retain adequate intermediate precision; all temperatures areK and no fuel-mass change is included in this ideal air-standard example.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને Model

T1=300K,T3=1200K,rp6,gamma1.4,cp1.005kJ/(kg·K),mdot2kg/s;ideal cycle.

Step-by-step ઉકેલ

  1. a=rp^(.4/1.4)=1.668510;T2=500.553K;T4=719.204K
  2. wc=201.556kJ/kg;wt=483.200kJ/kg;wnet=281.644kJ/kg
  3. qin=702.944kJ/kg;eta≈40.0663%;power≈563.287kW

Common Mistake / શરતો

Intermediate precision રાખો;બધાં temperatures Kમાં,આ ideal air-standardમાં fuel-mass change લીધું નથી.

body.en:
Definition / principle

For approximately adiabatic machines:eta c=(T2s−T1)/(T2a−T1); eta t=(T3−T4a)/(T3−T4s) in the constant-cp model.

Understand why

Actual compression reaches higher temperature/work than isentropic compression; actual expansion has smaller temperature/work drop than isentropic expansion. Pressure loss, heat loss, variable properties, fuel flow and mechanical auxiliaries further affect performance.

Common mistake / conditions

OnT–s, adiabatic irreversible machine paths move toward increased entropy; do not draw actual compression/expansion as identical vertical ideal lines.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Approximately adiabatic machinesમાં constant-cp model માટે eta c=(T2s−T1)/(T2a−T1);eta t=(T3−T4a)/(T3−T4s).

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Actual compressionમાં isentropic કરતાં temperature/work વધારે;actual expansionમાં temperature/work drop ઓછો.Pressure loss,heat loss,variable properties,fuel flow,mechanical auxiliaries વધુ અસર કરે.

Common Mistake / શરતો

T–sમાં adiabatic irreversible paths entropy increase તરફ જાય;actual compression/expansionને ideal જેવી vertical lines ન દોરો.

body.en:
Given and model

UseT1=300, T2s500, T3=1200, T4s720K; eta c.8, eta t.85, cp1.005; ignore other losses only for this comparison.

Step-by-step solution

  1. T2a=300+(500−300)/.8=550K
  2. T4a=1200−.85(1200−720)=792K
  3. wc=251.25; wt=410.04; wnet=158.79kJ/kg
  4. qin=1.005(1200−550)=653.25kJ/kg; eta=24.3077%

Common mistake / conditions

The temperatures here are explicitly supplied comparison states, not secretly rounded substitutes for a different pressure ratio.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને Model

T1=300,T2s500,T3=1200,T4s720K;eta c.8,eta t.85,cp1.005 લો;આ comparisonમાં જ અન્ય losses અવગણો.

Step-by-step ઉકેલ

  1. T2a=300+(500−300)/.8=550K
  2. T4a=1200−.85(1200−720)=792K
  3. wc=251.25;wt=410.04;wnet=158.79kJ/kg
  4. qin=1.005(1200−550)=653.25kJ/kg;eta=24.3077%

Common Mistake / શરતો

અહીં temperatures સ્પષ્ટ supplied comparison states છે;બીજા pressure ratioના છુપા rounded substitutes નહિ.

body.en:
Understand why

Split compression into stages and cool between them. Ideal intercooling reduces compressor work and can increase net specific work, but without regeneration it may increase required heat addition and need not raise cycle efficiency.

Common mistake / conditions

Count cooler pressure drop, fan/pump power and heat sink limits; state whether perfect intercooling and equal stage ratios are assumed.
body.gu:
કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Compression stagesમાં વહેંચી વચ્ચે cool કરો.Ideal intercooling compressor work ઘટાડે,net specific work વધારે;પણ regeneration વગર heat addition વધી શકે,efficiency જરૂરી નથી વધતી.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Cooler pressure drop,fan/pump power,heat-sink limits ગણો;perfect intercooling,equal ratios assumed છે કે નહિ કહો.

body.en:
Understand why

Expand partially in a high-pressure turbine, add heat in a reheater, then expand in a low-pressure turbine. Reheat can raise turbine/net work but extra fuel heat may lower simple-cycle efficiency without effective recovery.

Common mistake / conditions

The reheater is not an intercooler; reheat raises the expanding fluid temperature between turbine sections. Pressure loss and temperature/material limits remain.
body.gu:
કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

HP turbineમાં partly expand, reheaterમાં heat add,પછી LP turbineમાં expand કરો.Reheat turbine/net work વધારે,પણ extra fuel heatથી recovery વગર simple-cycle efficiency ઘટી શકે.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Reheater intercooler નથી;તે turbine sections વચ્ચે temperature વધારે.Pressure loss,temperature/material limits રહે.

body.en:
Definition / principle

A heat exchanger uses hot turbine exhaust to preheat compressed air before the main heater/combustor.

Construction:part and purpose

Separate hot-exhaust and compressed-air passages prevent intended mixing.

Heat-transfer surfaces/cyclic matrix transfer recovered heat.

Ducts/seals/bypass controls manage pressure loss and safe duty.

Temperature measurements establish heat recovery and the applicable effectiveness definition.

Working:flow and reason

Compare exhaustT4 with compressor-outletT2 before recovery.

IfT4>T2, heat can flow from exhaust to compressed air.

Preheated air needs less external heat to reach the same turbine inlet temperature.

For matched constant heat-capacity rates and ideal limits:epsilon reg=(T5−T2)/(T4−T2).

Common mistake / conditions

A fixed recuperator and a cyclic storage regenerator are different constructions even though introductory cycle notes group their recovery function. Pressure loss can offset savings.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Heat exchanger hot turbine exhaustથી compressed airને main heater/combustor પહેલાં preheat કરે.

Construction:ભાગ અને કામ

Separate hot-exhaust,compressed-air passages intended mixing અટકાવે.

Heat-transfer surfaces/cyclic matrix recovered heat આપે.

Ducts/seals/bypass pressure loss,safe duty સંભાળે.

Temperature measurements heat recovery,effectiveness definition આપે.

Working:Flow અને કારણ

Recovery પહેલાં exhaust T4,compressor outlet T2 સરખાવો.

T4>T2 હોય તો exhaustથી compressed airમાં heat જાય.

Preheated airને same turbine inlet temperature સુધી ઓછું external heat જોઈએ.

Matched constant heat-capacity rates,ideal limitsમાં epsilon reg=(T5−T2)/(T4−T2).

Common Mistake / શરતો

Fixed recuperator,cyclic storage regenerator constructions જુદાં,ભલે introductory notes recovery function સાથે લે.Pressure loss savings ઘટાડી શકે.

body.en:
Given and model

T2=500K, T4=720K, T3=1200K, epsilon reg.75, cp1.005; matched capacity rates, neglect pressure loss.

Step-by-step solution

  1. T5=500+.75(720−500)=665K
  2. Recovered heat=1.005(665−500)=165.825kJ/kg
  3. External qin with recovery=1.005(1200−665)=537.675kJ/kg
  4. Without recovery=1.005(1200−500)=703.5kJ/kg

Common mistake / conditions

Ideal work is unchanged only because machine states and pressure losses were held fixed here. Do not claim the same for every real recuperated plant.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને Model

T2=500K,T4=720K,T3=1200K,epsilon reg.75,cp1.005;matched capacity rates,pressure loss અવગણો.

Step-by-step ઉકેલ

  1. T5=500+.75(720−500)=665K
  2. Recovered heat=1.005(665−500)=165.825kJ/kg
  3. External qin with recovery=1.005(1200−665)=537.675kJ/kg
  4. Without recovery=1.005(1200−500)=703.5kJ/kg

Common Mistake / શરતો

અહીં machine states,pressure losses fixed હોવાથી જ ideal work unchanged;દરેક real plant માટે એવો દાવો નહિ.

body.en:
Definition / principle

A combustor stabilises continuous burning in compressed air while limiting pressure loss and delivering an acceptable turbine-inlet temperature pattern.

Construction:part and purpose

Diffuser/casing reduces incoming speed and distributes air.

Fuel injectors/atomisers and ignition provide controlled fuel introduction/light-up.

Swirl/flame-stabilising primary zone promotes stable combustion.

Liner cooling and secondary/dilution air manage metal and gas temperatures.

Can, annular or can-annular arrangements suit the engine design with qualified controls.

Working:flow and reason

Compressed air is decelerated/distributed.

Part supports flame stability and combustion; remaining air has cooling/completion/dilution roles.

Fuel burns continuously after authorised ignition in normal running.

Dilution sets the designed outlet profile before turbine entry.

Common mistake / conditions

The chamber aims for near-constant-pressure heat addition only as a cycle approximation; real pressure loss, emissions, flashback/blowout and hot spots require design/control.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Combustor compressed airમાં continuous burning stable રાખે,pressure loss limit કરે,યોગ્ય turbine-inlet temperature pattern આપે.

Construction:ભાગ અને કામ

Diffuser/casing incoming speed ઘટાડે,air વહેંચે.

Fuel injectors/atomisers,ignition controlled fuel entry/light-up આપે.

Swirl/flame-stabilising primary zone stable combustion આપે.

Liner cooling,secondary/dilution air metal/gas temperatures સંભાળે.

Can,annular,can-annular arrangements engine design,qualified controls મુજબ હોય.

Working:Flow અને કારણ

Compressed air decelerate/distribute થાય.

ભાગ flame/combustionમાં,બાકી cooling/completion/dilutionમાં જાય.

Authorised ignition પછી normal runningમાં fuel continuous burn થાય.

Dilution turbine પહેલાં designed outlet profile આપે.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Near-constant-pressure heat addition cycle approximation છે;real pressure loss,emissions,flashback/blowout,hot spots માટે design/control જોઈએ.

h.en: 7.3.6 Use cases, selection and exam answer

body.en:
Write a strong exam answer

  1. Compare power/drive/propulsion duties by net output, ambient sensitivity, part-load behaviour, fuel, emissions, start/response, maintenance and exhaust recovery options.
  2. Draw plant and cycle separately; label1–4, component work/heat, ideal/actual paths; calculatewc, wt, wnet, qin before efficiency; explain improvement trade-offs.
Can regeneration recover heat if exhaust is colder than compressor discharge?

Not the intended passive preheating duty; heat would not flow in that useful direction without a different device/input.
body.gu:
Exam Answer મજબૂત ગોઠવીએ

  1. Net output,ambient sensitivity,part-load,fuel,emissions,start/response,maintenance,exhaust recoveryથી power/drive/propulsion compare કરો.
  2. Plant,cycle અલગ દોરો;1–4,component work/heat,ideal/actual paths label કરો;efficiency પહેલાં wc,wt,wnet,qin ગણો;improvement trade-offs સમજાવો.
Exhaust Compressor Dischargeથી ઠંડો હોય તો Regeneration?

Intended passive preheating નહિ;અલગ device/input વગર એ useful directionમાં heat નહિ જાય.
